SLRC Assam Field Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: SLRC Assam has advertised 72 posts of Field Assistant (Statistics)/Enumerator. Of these, 22 posts are reserved for women (RFW). Three posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and 2 posts are shown for Ex-servicemen. The notification lists these under separate columns, so the PwBD and Ex-servicemen figures are shown below as given.

content_sections.heading: SLRC Assam Field Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have both English and any one of the Local Languages (Assamese, Bengali, Bodo) as subjects during HSLC. Candidates must have a valid Employment Exchange registration certificate in the State of Assam. Candidates already in regular Government service must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the Competent Authority as and when asked. Candidates have to submit a declaration regarding "The Small Family Norms" in Form-A as and when asked. Any candidate who wishes to be considered under the Assam Public Services (Preferential Appointment) Rules, 1999 will have to indicate their choice in the application portal.

rows.details: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university in any subject, having studied at least a paper of Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Social Science, Sociology or Psychology at graduate level
Bachelor's degree in any subject with 50% marks in Mathematics at 12th standard
English and any one Local Language (Assamese, Bengali, Bodo) as subjects during HSLC

Knowledge of Computer along with comfort in keying data through handheld device. Candidates must qualify and upload a Computer Course Certificate of minimum 6 (six) months duration from a Government recognized Institute.

content_sections.heading: DAHV Assam Field Assistant Age Limit
content_sections.text: A candidate should not be less than 21 years and not more than 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026. The upper age limit is relaxable for candidates of reserved categories as per existing provision. Age will be calculated on the basis of the HSLC/Class X Pass Certificate or HSLC/Class X Admit Card issued by a recognized Board/Council where the Age/Date of Birth is clearly reflected. No other documents will be accepted in lieu of these.

content_sections.heading: DAHV Assam Field Assistant Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates of any category do not have to pay any fee for the examination.

rows.scale_of_pay: Pay Band-2 of Rs. 14,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- + Grade Pay of Rs. 5,600/- plus other allowances as admissible from time to time

content_sections.heading: Documents and Certificates Mentioned in the Notification
content_sections.text: HSLC/Class X Pass Certificate or HSLC/Class X Admit Card showing Age/Date of Birth. Computer Course Certificate of minimum 6 (six) months duration from a Government recognized Institute. Caste certificate issued by the Government of Assam, for candidates seeking reservation as SC/ST/OBC/MOBC. It must be from the competent authority, clearly indicate the candidate's Caste, the Act/order under which the Caste is recognized as SC/ST/OBC/MOBC, and the village/town the candidate is ordinarily a resident of. PwBD certificate issued by the competent authority. To be eligible under the PwBD category, a candidate must possess Benchmark Disability of 40% or more. Ex-Servicemen Identity Card issued by Zila Sainik Welfare Office of the state of Assam and Discharge Book, for the reserved post. Valid Employment Exchange registration certificate in the State of Assam. No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates already in regular Government service, as and when asked. Declaration on "The Small Family Norms" in Form-A, as and when asked.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SLRC Assam Field Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the application portal at www.sebaonline.org. Apply online between 15 October 2026 (11.00 AM) and 14 November 2026 (23.59 PM). Fill in the application form with the required details and upload the required certificates, including the Computer Course Certificate. If you wish to be considered under the Assam Public Services (Preferential Appointment) Rules, 1999, indicate your choice in the application portal. Check the selection procedure and examination details published on the portal from the starting date of application.

content_sections.heading: SLRC Assam Field Assistant Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through www.sebaonline.org. The online link will be used for the application window from 15 October 2026 to 14 November 2026. No application fee is charged.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam (DAHV Assam) for filling up vacant positions under the ISS scheme.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DAHV Assam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 72 vacancies have been announced for the Field Assistant (Statistics)/ Enumerator position in this government recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in relevant subjects with Mathematics or Statistics at the 12th standard level along with adequate computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply for DAHV Assam Field Assistant?
faq.answer: The candidate's age must be between 21 and 40 years as on 01.01.2026, with admissible age relaxations provided for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for DAHV Assam Field Assistant (Statistics)/ Enumerator recruitment officially starts on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 14 November 2026. Applicants should apply early to prevent network congestion.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in Pay Band-2 ranging from Rs. 14,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- plus a Grade Pay of Rs. 5,600/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for candidates applying across all eligible categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for DAHV Assam Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Assistant (Statistics)/ Enumerator posts primarily comprises a Written Examination followed by merit-based selection.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official website www.sebaonline.org or by using the direct application link provided.
